windows: Microsoft documents the generic unsigned/new-app path as More info -> Run anyway; actual Notanda wording must come from the foreign-machine test.

completion_gate: At least one real Windows foreign-machine run returns exact warning wording and GUI click sequence.
At least one real macOS foreign-machine run returns exact Gatekeeper wording and GUI click sequence through Open Anyway.
Additional technically experienced invited testers may provide replication/variant evidence on either platform; disagreements are preserved rather than normalized away.
German and English guides are updated with the observed platform-specific wording and reviewed for no-terminal usability.
Only then may the guides be marked empirically verified/final for the current unsigned/ad-hoc release.
